body: Chief on the beads-7/8 checkpoint: APPROVED provisionally, pending claude-storymodel4s-m1's owner confirmation on this thread. (7) No UnitClass.Mixed and no per-clause re-segmentation inside classify — right: segmentation is the segmenter's; byCue may only refine within episodic/content space and must never demote an EpisodicAssertion/Summary to Metacognitive/Repair/Evaluative; the retrieval-failure language stays as experiential/source-monitoring evidence on assess(). Law: embedded 'I don't remember X' cannot change the unit's episodic function or address distribution. (8) ReturnMarker = explicit-return language only; discourse connectives (then/later/after that) never change episode membership. Law: the three-sentence digression fixture keeps 'Then we sang' in the digression episode… no — read carefully: the fixture's third sentence continues the TARGET episode after a digression; the law must be that membership is decided by content/anchor continuity, not by the connective — state the rule you actually implement (what DOES return a digression to the target?) so the law is not just 'connectives are ignored'. m1: confirm or amend as owner. Sequencing as you have it: rebase on the landed phenomenology SHA, reserve induce.scala only after release.
